title: Glyph v0: symbol table and call graph for one language, one repository
description: Narrow increment, chosen by the operator on DEC-65 (opum-doc seq 54, ODOC-OP-2026-09-29-32, 2026-09-29T23:51:46Z). Operator label verbatim: "Narrow increment now (Recommended)". Two traps that cost this session time. First, a git push composed with anything at all, including a trailing `; echo`, is refused by guard-composed-push: run it bare. Second, completing a task while checked out on a feature branch and then switching to dev restores the tasks/ copy from dev, producing task_lifecycle_duplicate_identity, which fails every quest command and would have failed the Tracker integrity gate: remove the stale tasks/ file in the same PR that lands the completion.

PROMOTION + RECURRENCE 2026-09-30: dev promoted to main at 4da4a2b (PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#11, auto-marked MERGED 00:12:32Z; evidence: push run 36648751520 completed/success on that exact SHA; landed bare via git push origin origin/dev:main). refs/heads/dev was then deleted again - OPAG-844 second occurrence: PR timeline head_ref_deleted 00:12:33Z, one second after the auto-merge; ls-remote and the branches API both showed only main immediately afterwards. opum-ai/glyph-cli#5 timeline carries the same merged -> deleted -> restored sequence for the 2026-09-29 occurrence, so the mechanism has two timestamped instances and is consistent with delete_branch_on_merge (true in repo settings) acting on the auto-merged dev-to-main promotion PR, whose head branch is dev. Evidence locations measured: the PR timelines carry both deletions and both restorations; the repository events feed carried only this occurrence (DeleteEvent ref dev 00:12:33Z) and not the first, so it is lossy - the timelines are the record. Recovered by recreating refs/heads/dev at the promoted SHA via the GitHub refs API; read back: ls-remote and the branches API show dev (protected) and main both at 4da4a2b; PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#11 timeline records head_ref_restored 00:14:10Z. (1) WHERE IT STANDS: branch feat/GCLI-2-glyph-v0 at e9efbbc, pushed to origin. It carries glyph v0 as source plus tests: package @opum-ai/glyph on Bun and TypeScript with commander; the indexer builds a symbol table and type-resolved call sites through the TypeScript compiler API checker; commands are callers <name> (option --file to narrow) and diff <base> [head]; a disposable local index cache lives under ~/.cache/glyph keyed by commit plus per-file stats; 19 tests, tsc --noEmit, biome lint and format:check all green locally. typescript is pinned at 5.9.3 because 7.0.2 ships no programmatic compiler API (probed: lib/ has tsc.js only). (3) DECISIONS not to re-derive: function-local variables are deliberately not symbols (they shadow the enclosing function in the diff query); dynamic callees are counted in unresolvedSites, never guessed; the diff query reports only the innermost touched symbol; ranges come from git diff -U0 with deletion-only hunks attributed at the insertion point; diff reads committed history only; contract - stdout carries exactly one success envelope, stdout stays empty on failure, exit codes 0 ok, 1 internal, 2 usage (ambiguous symbol included), 3 not-found.

(4) STANDING ITEMS: the promotion of dev to main is HELD until opum-agent reports DEC-70 landed; the operator chose A on DEC-70 (dev as the default branch) and is running the PATCH; after the next promotion, read origin/dev back and report whether dev survived WITHOUT a recreate - that read-back is OPAG-844 closing evidence. CONFLICT RESOLVED 2026-09-30, same session: the pull request read CONFLICTING because this branch was cut at 2ed3c26, before PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#15 landed the handoff note on dev (3c924d8), and both sides touched .quest/tasks/GCLI-2.json — dev modified it while the branch's completion had moved it to .quest/completed/. The empty re-trigger commit remains in branch history and is flattened at squash.
